The teacher stops Lais in the corridor and gives her four things to pass on. Lais writes them down before she forgets. In the group chat somebody says the presentation was cancelled. Dylan asks Lais to repeat exactly what the teacher said. Lais reports the four points in order and the misunderstanding is sorted out.
